svg.aria-label: Vector Search Engine: Search by meaning, every index written by hand. HNSW in NumPy + Numba, no FAISS or hnswlib: deletes, filters, hnswlib-level recall. 0.98 recall@10 at 0.15 ms on 120k embeddings, 60× faster than exact search. Same eval vs a pure-Python HNSW: recall@10 0.91 vs 0.62, ~240× faster. Stack: Python, NumPy, Numba, sentence-transformers.
